currentFocus: Giving every Play location one layout: the place and its people first, the thing you came to do next, and the numbers that explain it compact enough to read on a phone.

currentChange.summary: Standardised how every stationary location composes, so the primary activity is on screen when you arrive instead of below the fold.

latestCompleted.summary: Added Rusk Recovery and 10,000 Hours: Wade's own yard, a workbench that practises Welding indefinitely for scrap, and the Clean Pass moment every weld now rolls.

nextStep: Human mobile playtest across several locations to confirm the game reads as one interface rather than a collection of feature screens.

highlights.summary: Added Map MISSION and TURN IN destinations, blue turn-in guidance, compact Mission strips at the top of Play, and visible keyboard focus on beveled controls.
Extracted generic Play orchestration from the Mining feature into its own server and client boundary.
Made dialogue lifecycle aware of active versus completed state and one-shot presentation.
